name: Elevation Capital
identity_check: Elevation Capital at elevationcapital.com: an India-focused venture firm founded by Ravi Adusumalli (Co-Managing Partner, with Mukul Arora), with offices in Bengaluru, Delhi-NCR (Gurugram), San Francisco and Palo Alto. Formerly SAIF Partners: the firm's own Fund VIII announcement says "Elevation (then SAIF Partners)", Entrackr calls it "Elevation Capital (formerly SAIF Partners)", and Inc42 dates the rebrand to 2020. Confirmed by domain, the firm's homepage, team, sector and fund pages, and Inc42/Entrackr fund and round coverage naming the same funds and partners. LinkedIn company page: elevationcap. Not Elevation Partners or any other firm using the Elevation name; this file covers only the India-focused firm at elevationcapital.com.

open_items: No explicit statement found on investing in US-domiciled / flipped companies with Indian founders. requires_us_entity = 'no' rests on Elevation leading rounds in Indian companies (Jeh Aerospace, Hyderabad; Spill Games, Bengaluru; Presolv360, Mumbai) while also leading rounds in US-headquartered or US+India companies (Maxim AI, San Francisco; Adopt AI, San Francisco and Bengaluru). Partner Krishna Mehra is based in the San Francisco Bay Area; Entrackr (Dec 2024) says the firm 'looks to deepen its presence along the India-US corridor'. Elevation has San Francisco and Palo Alto offices.

No pitch form or application page on elevationcapital.com; the only contact is a general community email (not recorded). Philosophy page: 'It is never too early to reach out to us.' accepts_cold_inbound left 'unknown' because no channel for unsolicited pitches is described; application_url left out.

Check size: only the Apr 2022 Entrackr range ($2M-$75M per company 'in one or more rounds', i.e. total across rounds including growth) was found. No first-cheque size stated for Fund IX. A search-result summary attributed '$2-5 million' typical cheques to a 2025 report, but the fetched Entrackr page did not contain it, so it is not recorded.

Funds I-VII (SAIF Partners era) not itemised: the Fund VIII page says 'almost $2 billion of capital in over 150 companies across seven funds'; Inc42 says past funds ranged '$350 Mn to $670 Mn across multiple vintages'; Entrackr 2022 calls Fund VIII the fifth India-focused fund. Sizes and dates of earlier funds not found on fetched pages.
SAIF-to-Elevation rebrand: Inc42 says 2020; no rename announcement fetched for an exact date.

No manufacturing-specific investment statement. Frontier Tech page lists Industry 4.0 and Robotics; Enterprise AI page lists Physical AI and Vertical AI; Fund IX page: 'Indian robots will run factories that make for the world.' Entrackr 2022 listed manufacturing among sectors. Frontier-tech portfolio on the site: Detect Technologies, General Autonomy, Haber Water, Jeh Aerospace, PierSight, SolarSquare, Vegrow.

Rounds not recorded (no round article fetched): Composio, Zoca, Gale, Reo.dev, Polymerize, Detect Technologies, Plazza (perspectives/investing-in-plazza not fetched), PierSight seed (Jan 2024, co-led with Alpha Wave per a search snippet only), UnifyApps $11M seed (May 2024) and later rounds, Sahi Series B and Disha Series A (Elevation participated; seen only in search results).

Synthio Labs: a search-result summary named 1984 Ventures as a participant, but the YourStory article returned 403 and the fetched Inc42 article names only Peak XV Partners and Y Combinator; recorded as Inc42 gives it. The Portkey YourStory article also returned 403.

General Autonomy: valuation of about INR 280 Cr reported without saying pre- or post-money, so valuation_post_original left null. Its 2023 pre-seed (INR 25 Cr, led by India Quotient and Elevation Capital) is mentioned in the same article but not recorded as a separate round.
HQ country null for Dextr AI, Portkey, Synthio Labs, UnifyApps (offices Gurugram, Dubai, New York) and Adopt AI (San Francisco and Bengaluru) because the round articles do not name one headquarters.
Partner pages show portfolio only as unlabeled logos, so partner-to-deal mapping (e.g. who led Jeh Aerospace or Dextr AI) was not established.
